### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, touching **7** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via AUTHORING_RULES (symbol, a top-level const object))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 04f36b63f8d2f32b00428929b07268130881e30f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a820e9b5c395f0f57ce5d4fcdef29576b7912f6c` — the merge of head `647a1c1fda4e3b6426696b10e82370e612a558a4` into base `04f36b63f8d2f32b00428929b07268130881e30f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a820e9b5c395f0f57ce5d4fcdef29576b7912f6c && git checkout a820e9b5c395f0f57ce5d4fcdef29576b7912f6c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 04f36b63f8d2f32b00428929b07268130881e30f 647a1c1fda4e3b6426696b10e82370e612a558a4 && git checkout -B drift-repro 04f36b63f8d2f32b00428929b07268130881e30f && git merge --no-ff 647a1c1fda4e3b6426696b10e82370e612a558a4

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 04f36b63f8d2f32b00428929b07268130881e30f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 04f36b63f8d2f32b00428929b07268130881e30f` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `df13535218c10a428edd8c6c4d62a6f123b9ddc4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.test.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-page-field-bindings.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-page-field-bindings.test.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts + packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts (`assertSortFieldsExist`, `resolveQueryFields`), packages/lint/src/system-fields.ts (`SYSTEM_FIELDS`), packages/lint/src/validate-searchable-fields.ts (`indexObjectSearchTargets`), packages/spec/src/system/constants/system-names.ts (`SystemFieldName`), packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts, packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts, packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts, packages/lint/src/index.ts, content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx

Face: narrowing (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on the PR body and the changeset, line-initial on both). No published schema and no governed rules path is in the committed tree, so the narrowing face alone sets the tier. Review by an isolated reader of PR #30270 (card #30093); reads: card body and comments 6632471866 / 6648657894 / 6649613982, PR body, the full diff, the files named in `Scope:` at this head in a separate worktree, the head's check-runs and the base's (`6f095b9c`) dogfood job via the REST API. Nothing was built or run; the container carries no `node_modules` (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` stops for want of `tsx`), so every gate reading below is CI's or NOT MEASURED.

### ① Derived judgments

Declarations (PR body and changeset, both line-initial):

- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` — **right.** Nothing is widened: no new export (`packages/lint/src/index.ts` untouched; `checkPageSortDeclaration`, `validatePageSorts`, `isPageSortRef` are module-private), no new rule id (`page-field-unknown` / `page-field-unprovisioned` already exist in `validate-page-field-bindings.ts#PAGE_FIELD_UNKNOWN` / `#PAGE_FIELD_UNPROVISIONED` and are already exported), no new error code (`422 INVALID_METADATA` is the door's existing envelope), `SortableFieldFinding.rule` is `string`. The accept set only shrinks.
- `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` — **right.** A value a page author could write (a sort naming a field the object lacks) is now refused at the `page` publish door and by `os validate`/`os build`/`os lint`.
- `Skills-docs: none` — **wrong.** `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` §5 "Page components bound to fields that don't exist" (lines 164–170 on `main` and at this head) says: *"A `record:related_list`'s `columns`/`sort`/`filter` resolve against its related object (`objectName`) … Advisory, like form-layout field references — every consumer degrades rather than failing."* After this PR that sentence is false in the word `sort` twice over: §5's rule (`validatePageFieldBindings`) no longer resolves a related list's `sort` at all (`isPageSortRef` sets it aside), and an unknown name there is an `error` at the CLI and a `422` at the page door, not advisory. The dev's justification ("nothing there describes an unknown page sort as a warning") does not survive reading §5. `skills/**` carries nothing on it (checked `skills/objectstack-ui/{SKILL.md,rules/pages.md,rules/list-views.md}`); `os explain` texts for `page-field-unknown`, `sort-field-unknown`, `sort-field-unsortable` (`rule-explanations.ts`) stay true. The doc table "The one gate, four doors" has no row for `validateSortableFields` at all — pre-existing since #9257/#30084, not made false here. → must-fix M1 below.
- adr-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — reads right: no key added/removed/renamed; a refused name never sorted anything, so there is no FROM→TO. `Check Changeset` is green on this head; the local gate is NOT MEASURED (no `tsx`).

Accept-set changes, each judged:

1. **Page publish door (`PUT /api/v1/meta/page/NAME`, Studio/REST/MCP) now refuses `422 INVALID_METADATA`** a page whose element `dataSource.sort`, `record:related_list` `sort` / `parentDataSource.sort`, any `PAGE_BLOCK_SORT_OBJECT_PROP` block's own `sort`, `interfaceConfig.sort` or app-page `record.sort` names an undotted field the bound object does not declare and that is not a system name. Reached through `validateSortableFields` (`reference-integrity-suite.ts:294`, `runtimeTypes: ['flow','view','page']`) — the same member the door already ran for #30084, so no new door wiring. **Right.** Binding per slot (`validate-sortable-fields.ts#validatePageSorts`): `dataSource.object`; `dataSource.object ?? props[PAGE_BLOCK_SORT_OBJECT_PROP[type]]`; `parentDataSource.object`; `interfaceConfig.source ?? page.object`; `record.object` — the card's bindings, unchanged from #30084.
2. **Nothing is refused that the runtime accepts.** Door accept set (`protocol-query-validation.ts#resolveQueryFields` → `#assertSortFieldsExist`): `Object.keys(registry.getObject(o).fields) ∪ {id, created_at, updated_at}`, judged on the head segment. Lint accept set (`#checkPageSortDeclaration`): `target.names ∪ SYSTEM_FIELDS`, dotted names skipped, objects with no projection or no field map skipped. `SYSTEM_FIELDS` = `FIELD_GROUP_SYSTEM_FIELDS ∪ values(SystemFieldName)` and `SystemFieldName.ID = 'id'` (`system-names.ts:163`), so `id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `owner_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `organization_id`, `tenant_id`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `is_deleted`, `deleted_at` all pass lint. The registry's injected columns are a subset of that set, so lint ⊇ door on undotted names: over-inclusion is the stated posture (`system-fields.ts` header). A `formula` field is declared, so it passes existence and reaches the sortability verdict (`sort-field-unsortable`, unchanged). A lookup field name (undotted) is declared, passes. Dotted paths skipped — the door refuses them as its own verdict. Where the door returns no gate (legacy array field map, empty map) lint still judges a declared-map object by `recordsOf(fields)` — stricter than the door's existence check, but the field genuinely does not exist and the list-view sibling (`#checkSortDeclaration`) has judged that case the same way since #9257. No false-refusal scenario found.
3. **CLI (`os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`):** `page-field-unknown` on a related list's `sort` and on `interfaceConfig.sort` moves `warning → error`; the other four slot families move `silent → error`. **Right**, and one finding per slot: `validatePageFieldBindings` drops `sortFieldRefs(cfg.sort …)` and filters `split.related` through `isPageSortRef`; the new test "is the one reader of a page sort" asserts no `.sort` path from the bindings walk on all nine slots with a non-vacuity control on `columns`.
4. **Severity split vs siblings — consistent.** `checkFieldRefs` (`validate-page-field-bindings.ts`) grades `page-field-unknown` `error` when the consequence is `queried` and `warning` when `skipped`; a sort is a query position that the door refuses, so `error` is the `queried` grade. List-view twin: `sort-field-unknown` `error`, `sort-field-unprovisioned` `warning`. Provenance stays `warning` everywhere (`page-field-unprovisioned`; no door refuses it). Message/hint reuse `suggestName` and `unprovisionedAnchorVerdict/Fix`, the family's shared clauses.
5. **Public export change of `@objectstack/lint`: none.** `index.ts` untouched; exported `relatedListFieldRefs` / `sortFieldRefs` keep yielding sort refs (react surface and out-of-repo callers unchanged); `checkSortDeclaration`'s exported signature unchanged. Behavioural change on two exported functions is exactly what the changeset names.
6. **Import direction:** `validate-sortable-fields.ts` now imports two string constants from `validate-page-field-bindings.ts`; that file imports nothing from the sort module — no cycle.
7. **Overlap with #30095 (held serial):** none in code — this PR does not touch `runtimeTypes`. Note for #30095: once `object` joins that member's `runtimeTypes`, the object-write snapshot will carry pages too, and this PR's page-slot existence check will then also run on an object save; #30095's rollout decision should say whether that is intended.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/lint: minor` with `fix(lint)!:` title, BREAKING banner, both declaration lines and one adr-0087 marker in the body — **consistent** with AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3: `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` ⇒ at least `minor` on the package the diff moves. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` is touched only in a test file (`files: ["dist", …]` publishes nothing of it), so no changeset is owed there; the door's new refusal is the lint member's behaviour and is named in the lint changeset. `check-changeset-no-major` (local) exit 0; `Check Changeset` green on head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flag: stale comments in `reference-integrity-suite.ts:289` and `authoring-rules.ts:1253–1256`** ("judges it by the sortability projection alone"; "a stored page sort naming a field the list door refuses (`sortable: false`, a `formula`)"). Confirmed stale at this head. They are code comments, not accept set and not governed rules text (`reviewFace` on the PR's paths returns no `hits`), so not a must-fix on their own; the dev stopped at the claimed file surface as the claim instructs. Recommended: the seat widens the surface by those two comment hunks on the delta commit M1 already requires (cheaper than a card); otherwise a follow-up card. Should-fix S1.
- **Dev flag: `kind: 'react'` page sort props stay with `validate-react-page-props` at `skipped` (warning).** Accepted as out of scope: they are JSX props, not stored page sort slots; the card names stored slots only. A react `<ListView sort>` naming an unknown field still saves and still answers 400 at read — worth a card, not this one.
- **Dogfood (`!` title):** PR-level `Dogfood Regression Gate` check is `success` on `df135352`; the shard matrix is skipped on PR. The dev's full local battery on head reports 1 failure, `test/permission-set-clone-door.dogfood.test.ts › "a platform set … copies into its shipping package's pair"`. Read from the API: base `6f095b9c` job `Dogfood Regression Gate (2/3)` (id 127024968149) failed on step "Boot example apps and exercise real user flows" with the same FAIL line (`permission-set-clone-door.dogfood.test.ts > … copies into its shipping package's pair`, Test Files 1 failed | 139 passed). Same signature on the merge-base ⇒ not counted against this head. The diff touches no permission/clone path.
- **Check-runs at review time:** Lint ESLint, PM dispatch-gates, tooling self-tests, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Build UI Deps, Dogfood Regression Gate all `success`; Type Check ×5, Test Core ×8, Test UI ×16, Build Core, Live E2E UI and four Lint jobs still `in_progress`. All-green is the seat's landing precondition, not this verdict.
- `open_questions: []`; author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via relay (no human login to name).

### ④ Design judgment

Narrowing judged against the published spec and runtime on `main`: it takes no declared capability away — every page sort slot keeps its schema shape (`ElementDataSourceSchema.sort`, `interfaceConfig.sort`, `record.sort`, block `sort`), and a sort the door now refuses at save was already refused at every read by `assertSortFieldsExist` (`400 INVALID_SORT`, documented in `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` and `references/api/sortability.mdx`). It makes the spec's own refusal real at the earlier door. Door order (existence → provenance → sortability) mirrors `assertSortFieldsExist`'s `unknown > dotted > unmaterializable` precedence. The id choice (`page-field-unknown` rather than `sort-field-unknown`) is defensible — the author reads the page rule — and the one-line verdict pin now holds the two page ids to the same ≤200-char shape.

Against the card's acceptance: readers added for element `dataSource.sort`, `parentDataSource.sort`, `record.sort` (and the four block families) bound to the renderer's object — yes; severity decided (`error`) with the ADR-0087 disposition written — yes.

Tests: `validate-sortable-fields.test.ts` new describe asserts `[rule, severity, path]` tuples for all nine slot paths, the legacy string head / `-field` / comma forms, the three skips, provenance at `warning` on the external object with silence on the local twin, and the author-declared system-name fallthrough to `sort-field-unsortable`. The door suite asserts `status 422`, `code 'INVALID_METADATA'`, exactly one `page-field-unknown` issue with `severity: 'error'` at the slot path and `activePages(rows)` empty, for five slots, plus a CONTROL that saves the same five pages on `subject` and leaves one active row. Reverse verification is reported (8 lint / 5 door reds with sources restored). Readings are the dev's and CI's; NOT MEASURED here.

**Must-fix**

- **M1 — `Skills-docs: none` is false** (`content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` §5, lines ~164–170). Scenario: an author reads §5, writes `record:related_list.properties.sort: [{ field: 'ghost' }]`, expects "advisory … degrades rather than failing", and gets `422 INVALID_METADATA` from Studio. Fix either (a) amend the sentence in this PR — drop `sort` from the `columns`/`sort`/`filter` list and add one line that a page sort naming an unknown field is an `error` (`page-field-unknown`) judged with the sort rules and refused at the page publish door — and keep `Skills-docs: none` only if the dev also states the amended sentence; or (b) leave the doc and change both declaration lines to `Skills-docs: follow-up owed #N` with the card filed. Prose face: the lane seat checks the amended sentence against the diff at ACCEPT.

**Should-fix (same delta commit, seat's call on surface)**

- **S1** — refresh the two stale notes: `reference-integrity-suite.ts:289` ("by the sortability projection alone") and `authoring-rules.ts:1253–1256` (add existence `page-field-unknown` to the list of what a page write refuses).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-ru7gx5`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Utp6CbPxYq1wQmUNWvMZkC`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `647a1c1fda4e3b6426696b10e82370e612a558a4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts, packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts, content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx, .changeset/30093-page-sort-unknown-field.md + packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts (`validatePageSorts`, `checkPageSortDeclaration`), packages/lint/src/validate-page-field-bindings.ts (`isPageSortRef`), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts (`assertSortFieldsExist`)

Delta review by the same isolated reader, PR #30270 (card #30093), narrowing face. Previous record on `df13535218c10a428edd8c6c4d62a6f123b9ddc4` (PR comment 6649790600): FAIL on M1 (`Skills-docs: none` false against `validating-metadata.mdx` §5) with should-fix S1 (two stale code notes). This record judges the one commit `df135352 → 647a1c1f` (`docs(lint): say a page sort naming an unknown field is an error refused at the page door`); every ①–④ item of the earlier record that the delta does not touch stands as written there. Reads: `git diff df135352..647a1c1f` (4 files, +18/−5), the rewritten PR body, the head's check-runs, PR #27374's body (the dev's body-shape precedent). Nothing built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No source change.** The two `packages/lint/src` hunks (`reference-integrity-suite.ts:286–293`, `authoring-rules.ts:1252–1257`) are `//` comment lines only; no code token moves. `packages/metadata-protocol` is untouched. The accept set, the public surface and every reading in the earlier record's ① (accept-set items 1–7, severity split, lint ⊇ door on `id`/system names, no import cycle, no export change) stand unchanged.
- **M1 resolved.** `validating-metadata.mdx` §5 now reads "A `record:related_list`'s `columns`/`filter` resolve against its related object" — `sort` dropped, matching `isPageSortRef` filtering the bindings walk. The new paragraph is true sentence by sentence against the code at this head: the list door answers an unknown sort field `400 INVALID_SORT` on every load (`assertSortFieldsExist`); the slot list — element `dataSource.sort`, a related list's `sort` and `parentDataSource.sort`, a list block's own `sort` (the `PAGE_BLOCK_SORT_OBJECT_PROP` rows; "list block" is a fair docs-level name for list-view / related_list / line_items / object-grid / calendar / gantt / map / timeline), `interfaceConfig.sort`, an app page's `record.sort` — is `validatePageSorts`' walk exactly; "a field the bound object lacks" is `target.names ∪ SYSTEM_FIELDS` membership; `page-field-unknown` **error** is the finding `checkPageSortDeclaration` pushes; `422 INVALID_METADATA` is the door's envelope the gate test asserts. The following "Skipped" paragraph (relationship paths, registry-injected system fields, other packages' objects) applies to the sort slots too, and is true of them (`name.includes('.')`, `SYSTEM_FIELDS.has`, `!projection`).
- **Declaration lines (PR body and changeset, both line-initial):** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` — right, unchanged. `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` — right, unchanged. `Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` — **right**: `updated here` is one of SKILL.md's four spellings (`updated here | follow-up owed — FILES | follow-up #N | none — REASON`); the trailing path is an annotation no gate reads (no script greps `Skills-docs`), and it names the file the diff edits. `skills/**` carries nothing on page sort validation, so nothing else is owed there. The adr-0087 marker is unchanged and still right.
- **S1 resolved.** `reference-integrity-suite.ts` note now says the member also asks existence (`page-field-unknown`, `error`) and provenance (`page-field-unprovisioned`, `warning`) which `validatePageFieldBindings` no longer reads — true. `authoring-rules.ts` note now lists "a field the object does not have, as `page-field-unknown`" among what a page write refuses — true.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `@objectstack/lint: minor`, `fix(lint)!:`, BREAKING banner, one adr-0087 marker; only the `Skills-docs:` line of the changeset moved. Consistent with AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3. `Check Changeset` succeeded on this head (127052665625); a second run triggered by the body edit was `in_progress` at read time.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **PR-body shape.** Line 1 is the dev's signature (`domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_…`), lines 2–3 the attribution comment and "Requested by", line 4 `Fixes #30093`, then the three declaration lines. PR #27374 (merged 2026-10-29) carries the identical first four lines, and `PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path)` is `success` on this head after the rewrite (127063697444, started 05:12Z). Acceptable: the guards read the body as the dev shaped it and the precedent landed. The review-checklist's "正文首行引用卡片" read strictly puts the card on line 1; that is a TIER_DEFAULT ACCEPT item for the lane seat, not a contract defect, and the closing keyword sits alone beside the one card number (`check-closing-keyword-parity` green).
- **"Review round 1" section** names the round-0 record (comment 6649790600), M1 and S1 as taken, and 87 gate families run at `647a1c1f`; the body says the round-0 test / dogfood / reverse-verification readings still describe the code — true, since no source token moved.
- **Check-runs on `647a1c1f`:** every non-skipped run `success` — Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check (the two required floors), Type Check ×5, Test Core ×8 + aggregate, Test UI ×16 + aggregate, Build Core / UI Deps / Docs, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Documentation Links, Flag docs affected, Dogfood Regression Gate, Spec property liveness, PR-body guards ×2 — except one `Check Changeset` re-run `in_progress`. Dogfood shard matrix skipped on PR as before; the merge-base red (`permission-set-clone-door`, job 127024968149) is unchanged by a comments-and-docs commit.
- Earlier flags (react page sort props out of scope; #30095 overlap note) stand.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing itself is unchanged from the earlier record and stands: no declared capability removed, the spec's existing `400 INVALID_SORT` refusal made real at the page door. The delta only makes the prose faces say so. One docs-side observation, not a defect: the §5 paragraph does not mention that an author-declared field of a system name falls through to the sortability verdict, nor the one-reader guarantee; both are `os explain` / code-note detail, below the doc's altitude. The "one gate, four doors" table still has no row for `validateSortableFields` (pre-existing since #9257/#30084, noted in the earlier record, not owed here).

No must-fix. No should-fix.

## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · head `647a1c1fda4e3b6426696b10e82370e612a558a4` · card #30093 (claim 6648657894, amended 6649800491) · 2026-11-05T05:17Z

- **Shape:** draft PR to `main`, author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay), `Fixes #30093`; body's first line is the dev's signature line with the attribution block on lines 2–3 (same shape as merged #27374; `PR-body guards` success on this head). 9 files, +417 −48. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 30270`: NOT governed ⇒ not Tier H.
